evaluation.confidence_intervals: 95% cluster bootstrap over neighbourhoods, 1000 replicates, seeded; differences use the same resamples (paired)
evaluation.inner_tuning: 3-fold grouped CV by neighbourhood inside each training part; PR-AUC picks the grid point
evaluation.threshold: maximises F1 on the inner out-of-fold predictions, then applied to the held-out rows. Those predictions come from models trained on two thirds of the training part (XGBoost also early-stopped on the scored fold), so the F1 at this threshold is slightly optimistic

values.task: P(robbery | reported major property-type incident); every rung uses the same rows
